stem: Lot A and Lot B each finish at 90% germination, but Lot A reaches that result much earlier and more uniformly. What differs most clearly?
choices: Their final germination percentage is similar, but their germination rate/uniformity—and therefore vigor evidence—differs.
Lot A must have a different genotype.
rationale: Their final germination percentage is similar, but their germination rate/uniformity—and therefore vigor evidence—differs.
